items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk.

ctx.x: Roger was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 14, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in Los Angeles for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a real pleasure for me to have one of my favorite piano players and writers, Roger Kellaway.
